name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (inventory/give-item domain). No Ghidra address residue. Name accurately reflects the behavior: hand item_id to the first player-side (team==2) character whose backpack has a free slot, stopping at the first success. 'first' is faithful to the loop order; the 'has a free slot' nuance is captured in the comment.
purpose: Give an item to the first player-side (team==2) character that still has a free inventory slot; used by chapter end handlers to auto-distribute story gifts / key items.
logic_summary: Loops char_idx from 0 while char_idx < data_fd2_battle_party_member_count. For each runtime_char with team==2 (player), calls fd2_add_item_to_inventory(char_idx, item_id); if it returns != -1 (a free slot was found and the item added) the loop breaks/returns. If every player character's backpack is full the loop falls through and returns silently (item lost). team encoding: 0=enemy, 1=neutral NPC, 2=player.

params.name: item_id
params.semantics: Item id to hand out (caller passes a concrete item id: 0xC6 force/strength potion in ch02, 100 Sky Key in ch21). Forwarded directly to fd2_add_item_to_inventory; only its low byte is ultimately stored.
params.reason: Descriptive and accurate; the src declaration already uses item_id. Ghidra's raw param_1 is a placeholder; the canonical home-file name item_id correctly captures the value's role. No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. Success vs. failure (all backpacks full -> item lost) is not signaled to the caller.

notes: src comment block (status.c lines 1072-1093) is already accurate and concise (correct team scan, free-slot stop, silent-failure-when-all-full, correct team encoding, correct fd2_add_item_to_inventory return semantics, correct callers ch02/ch21) -> comment_verdict=keep, no edit made. Ghidra plate (Chinese) is detailed and consistent with the src understanding (same loop, same team encoding, same callers) -> plate_action=none, no plate change, no save_program needed. Field-name difference team (src) vs bTeam (Ghidra) is a runtime_char struct field naming detail, not a logic issue. Both callers verified: fd2_chapter_02_end (gift item 0xC6) and fd2_chapter_21_end (Sky Key item 100 on 6-item collection).
